instruction: Open the spreadsheet on Desktop. In row 7, add a note in column E that says 'Research papers on NLP'. Save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a specific note in cell E7. Evaluator checks if row 7 contains the expected text.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic verification failure: instruction requires adding text to specific column E (cell E7), but getter extracts entire row 7 and concatenates all cells
Evaluator will produce false positives: if text is added to wrong column (e.g., column C instead of column E), the metric will still pass because it searches entire row
Column specificity is completely lost: getter returns list of all cells which metric joins into single string, destroying positional information
Logic cannot distinguish between 'text in column E' vs 'text anywhere in row 7'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should extract specifically cell E7 (column 5, row 7) instead of entire row: ws.cell(row=7, column=5).value
Metric should check if the single cell value matches or contains the expected text, not search across concatenated row
Alternative: if checking entire row is intentional, simplify instruction to 'add note in row 7' without column specification
